name: io.github.cammac-creator/ibanforge
title: IBANforge
description: Check the bank behind an IBAN before you pay: bank-code check, BIC with source, bank-level sanctions

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional ifk_* API key: tool calls then count against it exactly as on the REST API, instead of the keyless allowance per source address. Authorization: Bearer ifk_* works too. A free key needs no e-mail: POST https://api.ibanforge.com/v1/keys/generate with an empty body.
